proof_spine: Keep anonymous forall rejected inside existential and set-builder bodies.
Name the pointwise choice condition with the builtin predicate is_choice_function_for.
Expose the general Cartesian product as a set-builder whose sole filter is that atomic predicate.
Verify both definition directions and use the named condition to introduce general-cart membership.

blocks.intent: Replace the removed anonymous-forall general_cart equality with a stable named-property interface.

attempts.candidate:
prop has_universal_self_equality(x R):
    forall y R:
        x = x

have universally_self_equal_reals set = {x R: $has_universal_self_equality(x)}

witness exist x R st {$has_universal_self_equality(x)} from 0:
    by def $has_universal_self_equality(0)

have I set
have S nonempty_set
have g fn(alpha I) S

general_cart(I, S, g) = {f fn(alpha I)big_union(S): $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)}

claim:
    ? forall f fn(alpha I)big_union(S):
        forall alpha I:
            f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
        =>:
            $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
    forall alpha I:
        f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
    $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)

claim:
    ? forall f fn(alpha I)big_union(S):
        $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
        =>:
            forall alpha I:
                f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
    $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
    forall alpha I:
        f(alpha) $in g(alpha)

claim:
    ? forall f fn(alpha I)big_union(S):
        $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
        =>:
            f $in general_cart(I, S, g)
    $is_choice_function_for(I, S, g, f)
    f $in general_cart(I, S, g)

        =>:

                f(alpha) $in g(alpha)
    forall selected_index I:
        f(selected_index) $in g(selected_index)

blocks.reusable_lesson: When a quantified condition must sit under an existential or set builder, name it as one atomic predicate and let ordinary definition inference expose its forall; claim premises are already staged and should not be echoed in the proof body.
